The '''Order of Sanctuary''' was a secret society of [[Gender/Legends|female]] warriors based in the remote areas of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The Order were patriots, pledging their support to protect the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo. The Order was so secretive that most of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] considered the organization to be nothing but tall tales. All of the Naboo's royal [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]] belonged to the Order.<ref name="RPG-Core" />
